remarks: This warm and inviting Colonial has been thoughtfully renovated thoughout, with a versatile open floor plan on the main floor. Sunny updated kitchen with white cabinetry, marble countertops, center island with seating area, and stainless steel appliances including Dacor cooktop, wall oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. New French slider leads from the kitchen to a large new deck and level rear yard, partially fenced. The dining room is open to the kitchen and includes built-in seating. A generous living room with fireplace is just off the kitchen/dining area, with plenty of extra space for an office area or den. There is also a half-bath with pedestal sink on the main floor. Upstairs is a large Primary Bedroom with a sliding barn door that leads to an updated full bath and a large walk-in closet with built-in shelving. The Primary Bath has double sinks and a beautiful step-in shower with rain head. A second bedroom with ceiling fan is adjacent to a renovated hall bath with tub/shower. There is a walk-up attic for storage, and a full unfinished basement with washer and dryer. Detached two-car garage. Central air, hardwood floors throughout. Gas heat, new hot water heater, new refrigerator. This home is in a great location, within easy walking distance to Main Street restaurants and shopping. Enjoy all that vibrant Norwalk has to offer, with MetroNorth train to NYC, SONO, Calf Pasture Beach and more.
